start: Settings, Health Connect page: 'Weight from Health Connect' row, off

user_sees: 'Weigh-ins from your smart scale or another health app go into your body weight by themselves. A weight you typed yourself is never changed.'
must_not: Weigh-ins read before the member taps

steps.action: Tap 'Read my weight' and allow Weight in Health Connect
user_sees: Caption 'On. When you open MettleUp, new weigh-ins from Health Connect are added to your body weight. A weight you typed yourself is never changed.'
'Added 3 weigh-ins from Health Connect to your body weight.' or 'No new weigh-ins in Health Connect yet.'
must_not: Readings older than 30 days pulled in on the first read
A reading outside the allowed kg range added

user_sees: The new weigh-ins with the line 'Weight from Health Connect'

start: Weight reading On; a new weigh-in arrived on the scale app

steps.action: Open MettleUp or come back to it (at least 10 minutes after the last read)
user_sees: The new weigh-in in the body-weight log; a line only when something was added
must_not: A line every time the app opens

start: Weight row, Health Connect refuses Weight or the phone holds demo data

steps.action: Tap 'Read my weight' and refuse in Health Connect
user_sees: 'Health Connect isn't letting MettleUp read your weight yet. Tap "Open Health Connect" below and turn on "Weight".'
'Read my weight' and 'Open Health Connect' buttons

steps.action: Load demo data and open the page
must_not: Real weigh-ins mixed into demo data

user_sees: 'Couldn't read your weight from Health Connect. MettleUp will try again the next time you open it.'
must_not: The 10-minute wait started by a failed read

start: Weight reading On, weigh-ins already added

user_sees: 'Stopped. New weigh-ins are no longer added. Weigh-ins already added stay in your body weight.'

steps.action: Type a weight for today, then turn reading on again with a scale reading for today
must_not: The typed weight overwritten by the scale

steps.action: Change a weigh-in that came from Health Connect, then a newer scale reading arrives

start: Weight reading On, member linked to a gym

steps.action: Weigh-ins come in from Health Connect
user_sees: Body weight on this phone only
must_not: Body weight from Health Connect sent to the gym, a trainer, advertisers or any AI

steps.action: Gym or trainer opens the member's progress
must_not: Body weight shown to the gym
